prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE independent transparent RGBA game HUD status icon, designed to be legible at native 32x32 pixels.
Primary request: redraw this original Empire C02 sci-fi status motif in the approved chunky matte art system. Image 1 is the exact identity/composition reference. Image 2 is the approved style/material reference only; never copy its tool subject. Replace Image 1's old glossy/noisy finish and opaque background completely.
Subject and invariant functional marks: Preserve the verified controlled-status motif: ONE small armored figure kneeling on folded legs, bowing its helmet slightly, with its TWO gloved hands together at its front and exactly TWO round amber restraint cuffs around the wrists. The helmet has a single cyan faceplate; armor is broad warm-gray/slate with charcoal joints. Behind the figure preserve the distinctive six branched angular amber control-circuit stalks, each ending in one large round amber node: one at far left upper-middle, one at upper left, one at top center, one upper right, one right-middle, one lower right. Keep these as solid bounded circuit lines with clear endpoint circles, not electrical arcs, flames or soft glow. Consolidate minor armor seams into a few chunky masses; kneeling posture, bowing visor, two cuffs and surrounding nodes must be unmistakable. No chains, weapons, warning labels, extra character or backdrop.
Style: match Image 2's broad sculpted polygonal planes, warm matte highlights, strong clean nearly-black contour, thick simplified internal separations and substantial toy-like construction. Very restrained detail. Polished hand-painted game art, not photography, vector signage, pixel art or a detailed tiny scene. Native32 clarity is the priority.
Composition: single centered isolated icon in a SQUARE canvas. Complete subject visible, around 84-88% of canvas extent, with genuine empty transparent safety margin all around. Preserve the main reference orientation. No part may touch or be clipped by the outer canvas.
Transparency: actual transparent RGBA background; every non-subject pixel fully transparent. Near-opaque material planes. Crisp antialiasing only on object edges. No background color, gradient, checkerboard, ground, floor, cast shadow, drop shadow, external bloom, haze, atmospheric wash, vignette, text, icon-panel border, signature or watermark. All colored accents remain on bounded subject shapes. Preserve explicitly requested solid circuit lines/ring marks, but never add glow around them. Outermost canvas perimeter fully transparent. One icon only, no sheet or alternate variants.
